scope: Read-only source and dry-plan inspection; no device access, firmware edits or long capture performed by reviewer.

findings.evidence: After a configuration ERROR, the existing loop continues if CAP8 cleanup and USB restoration were verified. It breaks only for interruption or unverified cleanup/restoration.
findings.required_action: Independent outer driver must stop on the first ERROR/non-CAPTURED configuration; preserve the failed result and do not retry automatically. Parent accepted this approach; existing runner source stays unchanged.

findings.evidence: BLE recorder default total ceiling is 4500s. Each suite segment has 45s prepare +5s warmup +120s capture +10s cleanup =180s; 32 segments have a 5760s combined ceiling before external process-launch/connection overhead.
findings.required_action: Use an explicit bounded BLE ceiling covering the chosen outer-driver total budget; 6000s is a reasonable finite ceiling if launch overhead is kept within its margin. Stop through stop-file at completion. Stop further configurations on unexpected BLE observer exit/disconnect; do not call uncovered windows zero FPS.

verified: configurations() produces exactly CAP/VOLT/RES/MIXED x rows1..8 =32 distinct cases; every requested capture is120s.
Capture begins after mode application,5s warmup and the before CONFIG bracket; preparation, warmup, queries and cleanup do not count as the requested120s capture.
Periodic diagnostics share existing capture deadlines while DATA is continuously pumped; they do not add to requested capture duration.
MIXED rows1 with full CVRCVRCV remains M/MR/K; only active row1 is CAP and wire profile is CNNNNNNN. It is not a homogeneous CAP benchmark.
Each segment checks immutable full configuration identity and CRC, records raw bytes with exclusive creation, and attempts bounded CAP8 cleanup. ADC accuracy is not inferred from capture completion.
Formal CDC role is selected by exact303a:4042/interface0/stable serial80B54ECDD9AC. USBSTREAM setters are prohibited on this backend.
BLE observer journals original notification payload bytes/base64 and host monotonic callback times; it sends no application mode/rate commands and never opens the CDC port.
Offline analyzer reassembles G fragments by(channel,messageID), verifies count/length/envelopeCRC, then parses scientific frameCRC and fullidentity; no assumed equal fragment sizes.

Offline analyzer aligns both ends of each frame to the corresponding USB capture interval, excludes boundary-straddling frames, checks continuous C/D/L subscription coverage, and labels incomplete/disconnected windows NOT_RUN.

BLE reassembly storage is bounded by4096 incomplete messages in the analyzer; incomplete messages are explicitly counted at eviction/end/disconnect. MessageID jumps are not interpreted as packet loss.
suggested_per_configuration_command: User DMM near ADS supply pins; temporary RAM3350000/-1795000uV with stated uncertainty, not precision calibration.
startup_notes: Start the receive-only BLE observer first and wait for its ready file reporting C/D/L subscriptions; use a fresh label/stop-file.
One formal CDC reader only. Do not run the standalone50-mode harness or another control reader concurrently.
Existing external rail evidence must match explicit user values; RAM calibration is only restored in query-verified CAP with INTREF off. No CAL SAVE, restart or rate setter.
Before advancing, outer driver must inspect the completed summary, requested duration, CRC/identity errors, CAP8 cleanup and BLE session availability. Preserve all failing evidence.
Capture throughput and BLE host receipt are distinct metrics; driver acceptance is not peer receipt.
